raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for your inquiry. We understand that your managed services team is currently exploring options and has not yet identified a specific requirement or project owner. To ensure we align with your needs, we recommend scheduling a discovery meeting to clarify what you need from Cedar Systems.

During this meeting, we can discuss how our workflow coordination and account reporting capabilities can support your goals. Please let us know a convenient time to proceed.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
questions: What specific goals or outcomes are you looking to achieve with Cedar Systems?
Are there any particular departments or teams that would be involved in this project?
